claims.text: A verdict under Spec 036 states only whether the registered criterion for PRED-2026-011 is met.
boundary: Scope claim for the whole spec. The registered prediction (docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md, PRED-2026-011) is the input, not a question; a verdict is a statement about the registered criterion on the registered data. It does not govern the step-0 checks (C04-C06, C09), the computation (C10-C11), or the register handling (C14). What the signs mean, why they pattern as they do, stability at any other site, and the positional behaviour of P000 are never judged under this spec. Confirmation against C15: C01 governs verdicts only and C15 governs closures only; a closure is not a verdict, so the two claims have different objects and cannot conflict.
alternatives: A scored prediction may be read as evidence about the script's decipherment or about sign meanings.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 outcome statement claiming more than the registered criterion's outcome on the registered data defeats this claim.

metadata.boundary_confirmation: C01 states this spec's scope (the registered criterion's outcome); C13 states the verdict wording's permitted independence claim and its required caveats. The two govern different objects - this study's outputs, and the wording of those outputs - and are consistent by construction: a verdict inside scope is exactly one whose wording claims only what C13 permits. Neither negates the other.

claims.text: The score is the share of trained signs whose Harappa start rate is at least 0.40.
boundary: The computation claim (spec section 5). A sign's Harappa start rate is the share of its Harappa occurrences, counted through its counterpart glyphs (C08) in the withheld Harappa sequences only, in which it stands in initial position - the first sign of a sequence, so a one-sign sequence's sign stands initial. The share is the count of trained signs at or above 0.40, divided by 2. No model, p-value, interval, or composition adjustment is part of the quantity. It does not govern the pass line (C02) or the zero-occurrence edge (C11).
alternatives: Start rates could be computed over all Yajnadevam sites, pooled with training counts, or adjusted for composition.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 product whose share is computed on anything other than the withheld Harappa sequences, or with a start rate defined otherwise than initial occurrences over total occurrences through counterpart glyphs, defeats this claim.
